# Waypost

Waypost is a local-first toolkit for students and jobseekers. No account is
required. Assets and computations stay on this origin in demo and PWA mode.

## Build status

M4: GPA planner, Final needed, Scale converter, Today, Tracker, import review,
Honest Match, Parse check and Resumes are available. Other tool routes are
placeholders until their milestone ships. The landing demo uses the same core.
Read PROGRESS.md; do not assume a placeholder computed a result.

## Matching and resumes

- app/resumes/: import a PDF, DOCX, TXT or JSON Resume, or create a text version.
  Versions stay in IndexedDB; original uploads use OPFS where available. Select a
  version to read a line and word diff and its effect on common scored jobs.
- app/match/: Import jobs accepts pasted descriptions separated by ---, plus TXT
  and JSON Clipper exports. Score N jobs runs every active resume × job in a
  module worker. Tier filters show counts. Select a job and resume version to
  expose the full evidence report in #result-data. Knockout answers are explicit;
  no answer is inferred from the resume. Failed knockouts cap the tier at Partial.
- app/parse/: choose a saved resume or upload a file. The text is shown in reading
  order with section labels and issue highlights. Download plain text saves the
  exact extracted text. Font/Unicode checks disclose when metadata is unavailable.
- Saved selection links: app/match/#job=JOB_UUID&resume=VERSION_UUID,
  app/parse/#resume=VERSION_UUID and app/resumes/#resume=VERSION_UUID.
  The full input/autorun deep-link grammar is added in M5.
- JSON copy/download is available for reports. Matching evidence is original
  resume text and line positions, with additional supporting lines when needed.
  Cluster gaps include count and total jobs; application questions remain separate.

## Routes

Use app/ relative to the deployment root (including a /waypost/ base path).
Tools: app/match/, app/parse/, app/resumes/, app/tracker/, app/gpa/,
app/finals/, app/scales/, app/offers/, app/deadlines/, app/letters/,
app/contacts/, app/agents/, app/settings/, app/setup/, app/share/, app/import/.
Future deep links use URL fragments, never queries, for private inputs.

## Tracker, Today and imports

- app/: next actions, pipeline in the last 30 days, per-resume replies/sent,
  recent best matches, storage estimate and credential-free workspace export.
- app/tracker/#view=board or #view=table: native board/table controls, sortable
  columns, stage filter, application details and history. Every card has a labelled
  Move to select. N opens a new job; M focuses the selected card's stage control.
- app/tracker/#add=1&title=Backend&company=Northwind opens a prefilled form.
  The application is written only after Save application. Selection links use
  #selected=APPLICATION_UUID&edit=1.
- app/import/#job=BASE64URL validates a Clipper envelope against
  schemas/job-export.json, then shows a review panel. Save jobs, Save & score, or
  Save to tracker confirms the selected writes. No import is saved automatically.
  File imports accept Clipper TXT/JSON exports and resume files. Plain-text jobs
  can also be pasted. Private fragment payloads are limited to about 32 KB;
  oversized captures use JSON export/import or paste instead.
- The Clipper's matching bundle is generated from the same core. Read this page
  injects the capture script on click. Site chips are off by default and require
  per-origin permission plus an explicit opt-in.

## Study tools

- app/gpa/: enter current/target CGPA and completed/remaining credits. Solve
  saves the target, updates Today, and runs the shared greedy course solver when
  courses exist. Select This semester or Whole degree (all planned terms).
  Course target locks stay fixed; difficulty is 1–3. Each course links to Final.
  Reported trend GPAs are distinguished from computed course averages, with a
  native table twin. Retake what-ifs disclose their counted-credit assumptions.
- app/finals/#course=COURSE_UUID: use the course target grade and saved assessment
  categories. Select exactly one unknown final category; weights must total 100%.
  Calculate saves the categories. The full cutoff ladder is in #result-data.
- app/scales/: select a source scale and CGPA; Convert saves inputs. Results have
  system, value (null when uncomputable), method, confidence and note. Cohort
  passing-student counts are required for ECTS. Edit institution tables creates
  inclusive, nonoverlapping ranges, and Export tables saves them locally.
- All three tools accept #plan=BASE64URL(JSON) for their input controls and offer
  Share link, Copy JSON and Download JSON. Private input is never in a query.
  Scale IDs reference built-in tables or custom scales in the local workspace.
- Built-in scale tables live in data/scales/. Core entry points are
  planTargetGpa/solveCourseMix, finalNeeded/finalLadder and convertGradeScale.
  Every computation updates #result-data; writes use explicit Save/Calculate/Solve.

## Results and stable hooks

Every tool page has a JSON script #result-data, initially null. The landing
demo updates it on each match. Native controls have accessible names.
data-testid values: `result-data`, `open-search`, `clear-demo`, `footer-credit`,
`hero-jd`, `hero-resume`, `hero-upload`, `score-button`, `requirement-row`,
`copy-json`, `download-json`, `job-row`, `resume-tab`, `resume-version`,
`parse-line`, `parse-check`, `diff-row`, `tracker-card`, `move-to-menu`,
`next-up-row`, `pipeline-row`, `response-rate-row`, `export-button`,
`import-job-row`, `import-confirm-save`, `gpa-solve`, `gpa-result`, `course-row`,
`course-lock`, `trend-row`, `grade-scale-row`, `final-calculate`, `final-category-row`,
`final-ladder-row`, `scale-convert`, `conversion-row`. Requirement rows have data-status met/partial/missing.
Navigation uses nav-<route>. Read the JSON for all requirements; the hero shows
representative rows. No employer hiring outcome is predicted by the tier.
Every actionable native control also has its own test hook. Native names are the
preferred way to operate the UI. Add to tracker asks for in-page confirmation.
That application record is saved locally and can be edited in Tracker.
